blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five angle views and six current pose renders for V18 after rerunning 3D manufacturing from build-blender. The back view retains a raised center patch; front and three-quarter show fabric gathered into a central block; crouch and sit show long pointed tails hanging below the seat. Lowering overskirt cloth bending stiffness from 20 to 8 did not materially resolve the silhouette. Appearance remains rejected.

Current crouch and sit renders still show shorts and the inner-hip boundary crowded by the pose, with pointed skirt panels extending below the seat. Static images do not establish continuous coverage, clearance or strain; fit remains unverified and rejected.
Current front, side, back and posed renders show pronounced triangular faceting across jacket sleeves, shoulders, torso and waist. Surface finish remains rejected.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
